package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
)

const validationLease = 5 * time.Minute

type Repository struct{ db *sql.DB }

func NewRepository(db *sql.DB) *Repository { return &Repository{db: db} }

var _ ports.Repository = (*Repository)(nil)

func (repository *Repository) ready() error {
	if repository == nil || repository.db == nil {
		return domain.ErrDependency
	}
	return nil
}

func translateError(err error) error {
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	var postgresError *pgconn.PgError
	if errors.As(err, &postgresError) {
		switch postgresError.Code {
		case "23505", "23503", "23514":
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: persistence constraint %s", domain.ErrConflict, postgresError.ConstraintName)
		}
	}
	return err
}

func (repository *Repository) CreateOrLoadStart(ctx context.Context, instance domain.TaskInstance) (domain.TaskInstance, bool, error) {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, false, err
	}
	if instance.ID == "" || instance.StudentID == "" || instance.TaskRevisionID == "" || instance.StartCommandDigest == "" || instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceStarting {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, false, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	instance.Version = 1
	payload, err := marshalInstance(instance)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, false, err
	}
	result, err := repository.db.ExecContext(ctx, `
INSERT INTO practice_task_instances
    (id,student_id,task_revision_id,task_revision_digest,status,start_command_digest,
     current_submission_id,final_submission_id,version,payload,started_at,updated_at,completed_at)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,1,$9::jsonb,$10,$11,$12)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING`, instance.ID, instance.StudentID, instance.TaskRevisionID,
		instance.TaskRevisionDigest, instance.Status, instance.StartCommandDigest,
		nullableUUID(instance.CurrentSubmissionID), nullableUUID(instance.FinalSubmissionID), payload,
		instance.StartedAt.UTC(), instance.UpdatedAt.UTC(), nullableTime(instance.CompletedAt))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, false, translateError(err)
	}
	affected, err := result.RowsAffected()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, false, err
	}
	if affected == 1 {
		return instance, true, nil
	}
	stored, err := repository.getInstanceByID(ctx, instance.ID, false)
	return stored, false, err
}

func (repository *Repository) GetInstance(ctx context.Context, studentID, instanceID string) (domain.TaskInstance, error) {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, err
	}
	var payload []byte
	err := repository.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT payload FROM practice_task_instances WHERE student_id=$1 AND id=$2`, studentID, instanceID).Scan(&payload)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, translateError(err)
	}
	instance, err := unmarshalInstance(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, fmt.Errorf("decode persisted TaskInstance: %w", err)
	}
	return instance, nil
}

func (repository *Repository) GetInstanceByID(ctx context.Context, instanceID string) (domain.TaskInstance, error) {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, err
	}
	return repository.getInstanceByID(ctx, instanceID, false)
}

func (repository *Repository) getInstanceByID(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, forUpdate bool) (domain.TaskInstance, error) {
	query := `SELECT payload,version FROM practice_task_instances WHERE id=$1`
	if forUpdate {
		query += ` FOR UPDATE`
	}
	var payload []byte
	var version int64
	if err := repository.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, query, instanceID).Scan(&payload, &version); err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, translateError(err)
	}
	instance, err := unmarshalInstance(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, fmt.Errorf("decode persisted TaskInstance: %w", err)
	}
	instance.Version = version
	return instance, nil
}

func (repository *Repository) ListInstances(ctx context.Context, studentID, cursor string, limit int, status domain.TaskInstanceStatus) ([]domain.TaskInstance, string, error) {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	if limit < 1 || limit > 100 {
		return nil, "", domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	var rows *sql.Rows
	var err error
	if cursor == "" {
		rows, err = repository.db.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT payload,id FROM practice_task_instances
WHERE student_id=$1 AND ($2='' OR status=$2) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $3`, studentID, status, limit+1)
	} else {
		decoded, decodeErr := decodeHexCursor(cursor)
		if decodeErr != nil {
			return nil, "", domain.ErrInvalid
		}
		rows, err = repository.db.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT payload,id FROM practice_task_instances
WHERE student_id=$1 AND id < $2 AND ($3='' OR status=$3) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $4`, studentID, decoded, status, limit+1)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", translateError(err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	items := make([]domain.TaskInstance, 0, limit+1)
	ids := make([]string, 0, limit+1)
	for rows.Next() {
		var raw []byte
		var id string
		if err := rows.Scan(&raw, &id); err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
		instance, err := unmarshalInstance(raw)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("decode persisted TaskInstance: %w", err)
		}
		items, ids = append(items, instance), append(ids, id)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	var next string
	if len(items) > limit {
		items = items[:limit]
		next = hex.EncodeToString([]byte(ids[limit-1]))
	}
	return items, next, nil
}

func (repository *Repository) SaveInstance(ctx context.Context, instance domain.TaskInstance) (domain.TaskInstance, error) {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, err
	}
	tx, err := repository.db.BeginTx(ctx, &sql.TxOptions{Isolation: sql.LevelReadCommitted})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
	var raw []byte
	var version int64
	err = tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT payload,version FROM practice_task_instances WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE`, instance.ID).Scan(&raw, &version)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, translateError(err)
	}
	current, err := unmarshalInstance(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, fmt.Errorf("decode persisted TaskInstance: %w", err)
	}
	current.Version = version
	if instance.Version != version {
		candidate := instance
		candidate.Version = version
		if version == instance.Version+1 && sameInstance(current, candidate) {
			if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
				return domain.TaskInstance{}, err
			}
			return current, nil
		}
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if err := validateInstanceUpdate(current, instance); err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, err
	}
	instance.Version = version + 1
	payload, err := marshalInstance(instance)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, err
	}
	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_task_instances
SET task_revision_id=$2,task_revision_digest=$3,status=$4,current_submission_id=$5,final_submission_id=$6,
    version=$7,payload=$8::jsonb,updated_at=$9,completed_at=$10
WHERE id=$1 AND version=$11`, instance.ID, instance.TaskRevisionID, instance.TaskRevisionDigest, instance.Status,
		nullableUUID(instance.CurrentSubmissionID), nullableUUID(instance.FinalSubmissionID), instance.Version,
		payload, instance.UpdatedAt.UTC(), nullableTime(instance.CompletedAt), version)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, translateError(err)
	}
	affected, err := result.RowsAffected()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, err
	}
	if affected != 1 {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, err
	}
	return instance, nil
}

func validateInstanceUpdate(current, next domain.TaskInstance) error {
	if current.ID != next.ID || current.StudentID != next.StudentID || current.TaskRevisionID != next.TaskRevisionID ||
		current.TaskRevisionDigest != next.TaskRevisionDigest || current.StartCommandDigest != next.StartCommandDigest ||
		current.SurfaceClassification != next.SurfaceClassification || current.Locale != next.Locale || current.StartedAt != next.StartedAt ||
		current.LearningPathID != next.LearningPathID || current.SolutionVariantID != next.SolutionVariantID || current.LearningPathItemID != next.LearningPathItemID || current.RequirementID != next.RequirementID ||
		!sameRevisionBinding(current, next) || !sameFrozenSteps(current.Steps, next.Steps) ||
		(current.LearningActionID != "" && current.LearningActionID != next.LearningActionID) ||
		(current.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID != "" && current.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID != next.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID) ||
		(current.LearningRoute.ID != "" && !sameRoute(current.LearningRoute, next.LearningRoute)) {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if current.Status != next.Status && !domain.CanTransitionInstance(current.Status, next.Status) {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if !validProgressProjection(next) {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return nil
}

func sameRevisionBinding(left, right domain.TaskInstance) bool {
	leftBytes, leftErr := json.Marshal(struct {
		Summary  storedRevisionSummary
		Envelope domain.RevisionEnvelope
	}{storeRevisionSummary(left.RevisionSummary), left.RevisionEnvelope})
	rightBytes, rightErr := json.Marshal(struct {
		Summary  storedRevisionSummary
		Envelope domain.RevisionEnvelope
	}{storeRevisionSummary(right.RevisionSummary), right.RevisionEnvelope})
	return canonicalEqual(leftBytes, rightBytes, leftErr, rightErr)
}

func sameFrozenSteps(left, right []domain.Step) bool {
	if len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range left {
		leftCopy, rightCopy := left[index], right[index]
		leftCopy.Status, rightCopy.Status = "", ""
		leftCopy.ReadinessReceipt, rightCopy.ReadinessReceipt = nil, nil
		leftCopy.ReadinessIdempotencyKey, rightCopy.ReadinessIdempotencyKey = "", ""
		leftCopyBytes, leftErr := json.Marshal(storeStep(leftCopy))
		rightCopyBytes, rightErr := json.Marshal(storeStep(rightCopy))
		if !canonicalEqual(leftCopyBytes, rightCopyBytes, leftErr, rightErr) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func sameRoute(left, right domain.LearningRouteReceipt) bool {
	leftBytes, leftErr := json.Marshal(left)
	rightBytes, rightErr := json.Marshal(right)
	return canonicalEqual(leftBytes, rightBytes, leftErr, rightErr)
}

func validProgressProjection(instance domain.TaskInstance) bool {
	passed, total := 0, 0
	for _, step := range instance.Steps {
		if !step.Required {
			continue
		}
		total++
		if step.Status == "PASSED" || step.Status == "CHECKPOINTED" {
			passed++
		}
	}
	percentage := float64(0)
	if total > 0 {
		percentage = float64(passed) * 100 / float64(total)
	}
	return instance.Progress.PassedSteps == passed && instance.Progress.TotalSteps == total && instance.Progress.Percentage == percentage
}

func sameInstance(left, right domain.TaskInstance) bool {
	leftBytes, leftErr := marshalInstance(left)
	rightBytes, rightErr := marshalInstance(right)
	return canonicalEqual(leftBytes, rightBytes, leftErr, rightErr)
}

func canonicalEqual(left, right []byte, leftErr, rightErr error) bool {
	if leftErr != nil || rightErr != nil {
		return false
	}
	leftCanonical, leftErr := domain.CanonicalJSON(left)
	rightCanonical, rightErr := domain.CanonicalJSON(right)
	return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && string(leftCanonical) == string(rightCanonical)
}

func decodeHexCursor(cursor string) (string, error) {
	decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(cursor)
	if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(string(decoded)) == "" {
		return "", domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	return string(decoded), nil
}

func encodeCursor(value string) string { return hex.EncodeToString([]byte(value)) }

func parseSubmissionCursor(cursor string) (time.Time, string, error) {
	decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(cursor)
	if err != nil {
		return time.Time{}, "", domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	parts := strings.SplitN(string(decoded), "|", 2)
	if len(parts) != 2 {
		return time.Time{}, "", domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	at, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, parts[0])
	if err != nil || parts[1] == "" {
		return time.Time{}, "", domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	return at.UTC(), parts[1], nil
}

func formatSubmissionCursor(at time.Time, id string) string {
	return encodeCursor(at.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano) + "|" + id)
}
